name: SamurAI Shield :: Apache Tomcat update
description: Input contract for playbooks/tomcat_update_with_evidence.yml (repo: prfsouto/samurai-aap-playbooks). Patches a self-managed Apache Tomcat install (not an rpm/dpkg package) via a sibling-directory build + stable-symlink cutover, migrating conf/custom-webapps/extra-jars from the current install. HOSTNAMES is auto-filled by SamurAI Shield from the governed asset and hidden from the operator form. IMPORTANT: enable 'Prompt on launch -> Extra variables' (ask_variables_on_launch) on the Job Template so the engine's governed HOSTNAMES overrides the survey's blank default instead of being discarded.

spec.question_description: Single host, IP, or space/comma-separated list. Filled automatically by SamurAI Shield from the selected asset — do not type it by hand.
Absolute path the target's systemd service references today (a symlink, or a real version-named directory — the playbook detects which).
The systemd unit that fronts this Tomcat (e.g. tomcat).
Exact version to converge on, e.g. 9.0.121. Never "latest" — the scope can never be guessed.
Check reports the installed version vs the target and a services/ports baseline, read-only. Apply downloads, verifies, stages, migrates and cuts over.
Required when ACTION=Apply: the exact tar.gz for TARGET_VERSION.
Required when ACTION=Apply: the artifact is never installed without a matching checksum.
Base directory on the target where the structured evidence files are written.
